issue_context.title: Support RETURNING clause in SQLite
issue_context.body:
## Feature Description

Sqliti added support for [RETURNING clause](https://www.sqlite.org/lang_returning.html) in [3.35 release](https://www.sqlite.org/releaselog/3_35_0.html).

Currently, TypeORM always assume that Sqlite don't have support for this feature.

### Additional Context

Runtime check should be performed in `isReturningSqlSupported`.

For `better-sqlite3` it can be done be creating in-memory database and destroying it:

```ts
 (new (require('better-sqlite3')))(':memory:').prepare('SELECT sqlite_version()').pluck().get();
```

For `sqlite3` version can be get from:

```ts
require('sqlite3').VERSION_NUMBER
```

I'm not sure about other SQLite drivers.
